keyEvents.text: First Half ends, Sporting Lisbon 0, Moreirense 0.
Substitution, Moreirense. Maranhão replaces Leonardo Vonic.
Substitution, Moreirense. Leandro Santos replaces Chipyoka Songa.
Goal! Sporting Lisbon 1, Moreirense 0. Luis Suárez (Sporting Lisbon) left footed shot from the right side of the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Issa Doumbia following a fast break.
Substitution, Sporting Lisbon. Rodrigo Zalazar replaces Nestory Irankunda.
Substitution, Sporting Lisbon. Flávio Gonçalves replaces Issa Doumbia.
Substitution, Sporting Lisbon. Geny Catamo replaces Luís Guilherme.
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, Moreirense. Rodri Alonso replaces Landerson.
Substitution, Sporting Lisbon. Fotis Ioannidis replaces Luis Suárez.
Substitution, Moreirense. Afonso Vieira replaces Guilherme Liberato.
Substitution, Moreirense. Mateja Stjepanovic replaces Álvaro Martínez.
